full.name: Full Version
full.desc: Removes the 30% cap on every constellation; later songs still unlock when you clear them. One-time purchase: no subscription, no ads.

bg.stars.name: Night Sky
bg.stars.desc: How the game looks now: a dark night sky whose tint drifts slowly with the song.

bg.aurora.name: Aurora
bg.aurora.desc: Green-blue aurora curtains flow across the night sky, with a still lake reflecting the light below snowy ridges.

bg.city.name: Neon City
bg.city.desc: A retro striped sunset, two layers of skyline and flickering neon signs, with the ground grid rolling ever forward.

bg.sakura.name: Cherry Blossom Night
bg.sakura.desc: Cherry blossoms under the moon; petals drift down and settle on the ground.

bg.sea.name: Deep Sea
bg.sea.desc: Light beams from the surface, stingrays, schools of fish, glowing jellyfish and coral, with bubbles slowly rising.

bg.lava.name: Lava
bg.lava.desc: Dark red magma and rising embers, a smoking volcano and glowing cracks in the rock.

bg.snow.name: Snowfield
bg.snow.desc: A snowy night sky with snow-capped peaks, a frozen lake, a little cabin and falling snow.

bg.grid.name: Pixel Grid
bg.grid.desc: An 8-bit pixel night sky, scrolling pixel mountains and arcade scanlines.

bg.candy.name: Glow Candy
bg.candy.desc: A deep plum night, a doughnut moon, frosted hills and falling sprinkles.

bg.nebula.name: Nebula
bg.nebula.desc: Layers of glowing gas, dark pillars of dust and newborn stars.

bg.paper.name: Ink Landscape
bg.paper.desc: An ink-wash night scene with layered distant mountains and a little boat.

bg.gold.name: Golden Constellation
bg.gold.desc: A slowly turning zodiac ring and golden constellation lines.

bg.mysky.name: My Star Map
bg.mysky.desc: A night sky drawn from your own clear records: every song you have cleared becomes a star.

frame.glow.name: Glow
frame.glow.desc: How the game looks now: two bright thumb lines.

frame.neon.name: Neon Tube
frame.neon.desc: Thick, bright neon tubes with a white core.

frame.gold.name: Gilded
frame.gold.desc: A shimmering metal frame with a star set in each corner.

frame.ice.name: Icicle
frame.ice.desc: A frosted frame with icicles hanging from the top edge.

frame.rainbow.name: Rainbow Flow
frame.rainbow.desc: Rainbow colors flow along the frame.

frame.pixel.name: Pixel Line
frame.pixel.desc: A frame made of dotted pixel blocks.

frame.ink.name: Ink Line
frame.ink.desc: Lines drawn with a brush and ink.

orb.circle.name: Light Dot
orb.circle.desc: How the game looks now; changes color with your combo.

orb.star.name: Faceted Star
orb.star.desc: Each point of the five-pointed star is split into a light and a dark face; the tips flash as it spins.

orb.heart.name: Heartbeat
orb.heart.desc: Beats with a double thump, with two little hearts circling around it.

orb.note.name: Double Notes
orb.note.desc: Bold beamed sixteenth notes that bob up and down with the beat, with sound waves rippling out on both sides.

orb.gem.name: Octahedron
orb.gem.desc: A spinning 3D octahedron, each face shaded differently.

orb.pixel.name: Pixel Sprite
orb.pixel.desc: An 8-bit two-frame animation surrounded by pixel sparkles.

orb.moon.name: Crescent
orb.moon.desc: The moon shifts between a new moon and a half moon, with a little star swinging below.

orb.ring.name: Banded Planet
orb.ring.desc: A wide double ring with flowing stripes that spins faster when you hit the ball; the moon circles behind the planet.

orb.petal.name: Double Blossom
orb.petal.desc: Inner and outer petals spin in opposite directions around a center of stamens.

orb.bubble.name: Rainbow Bubble
orb.bubble.desc: The rainbow sheen on the bubble film flows and wobbles slightly.

orb.vinyl.name: Vinyl Record
orb.vinyl.desc: A spinning record: grooves, a colorful label and glints of light.

orb.disco.name: Disco Ball
orb.disco.desc: Little mirror tiles take turns catching the light and shooting out beams.

orb.pinwheel.name: Pinwheel
orb.pinwheel.desc: Four curled blades in two alternating colors.

orb.gear.name: Gear
orb.gear.desc: A ten-tooth gear with spokes in the middle.

orb.shuriken.name: Shuriken
orb.shuriken.desc: A four-bladed metal throwing star with gleaming edges.

orb.propeller.name: Electric Fan
orb.propeller.desc: Blades spin inside a fixed guard; hit it and it spins faster and blows out a breeze.

orb.galaxy.name: Spiral Galaxy
orb.galaxy.desc: Two spiral arms made of star dots.

orb.snowstar.name: Snow Crystal
orb.snowstar.desc: A six-armed snowflake crystal with branching tips.

orb.boomerang.name: Boomerang
orb.boomerang.desc: A three-blade boomerang with bright edge lines.

orb.ink.name: Ink Bead
orb.ink.desc: An ink-bead orb with your combo color showing through the outer ring.

orb.core.name: Star Core
orb.core.desc: The higher your combo, the fuller its form: dot → ring → four-point → eight-point → frame → flare → rainbow crystal → golden crown, 8 forms in all.

trail.ribbon.name: Light Ribbon
trail.ribbon.desc: How the game looks now; changes color with your combo.

trail.braid.name: Triple Braid
trail.braid.desc: Three fine strands twisting around each other.

trail.spark.name: Spark
trail.spark.desc: Sparks fly outward and fall with gravity, leaving only a thin line.

trail.flame.name: Flame Tongue
trail.flame.desc: A flickering flame shape with drifting embers.

trail.comet.name: Comet Tail
trail.comet.desc: A tail of gold-white dust stretching straight back from the orb’s direction of travel, with a blue ion streak drifting behind it.

trail.lightning.name: Lightning
trail.lightning.desc: A jagged, forking electric arc redrawn every frame.

trail.ghost.name: Afterimage
trail.ghost.desc: The orb’s outline is left behind ring by ring, then fades.

trail.bubble.name: Bubbles
trail.bubble.desc: No ribbon, only bubbles that wobble upward.

trail.petal.name: Flower Vine
trail.petal.desc: Vines grow along the path, with blooms getting bigger toward the back and the odd petal falling.

trail.snow.name: Frost Crystal
trail.snow.desc: Curved frost feathers grow along the path, tips glinting softly as ice dust drifts down.

trail.pixel.name: Pixel Stairs
trail.pixel.desc: Grid-aligned blocks stepping along in a staircase.

trail.note.name: Music Staff
trail.note.desc: A music staff that bends with the orb, with notes sitting on the lines.

hit.ring.name: Halo
hit.ring.desc: How the game looks now: two rings of light and a burst of sparks.

hit.starburst.name: Starburst
hit.starburst.desc: A cross of light flashes and turns, with a ring of little stars circling the hit point.

hit.firework.name: Fireworks
hit.firework.desc: A main burst followed by three delayed small ones.

hit.splash.name: Splash
hit.splash.desc: A ring of droplets, two ripples and a fine mist.

hit.petal.name: Bloom & Fall
hit.petal.desc: A flower blooms on the wall, then its petals flip and drift down one by one.

hit.shatter.name: Ice Shatter
hit.shatter.desc: A cluster of ice crystals grows at the wall, cracks, and the shards fall.

hit.pixel.name: Pixel Blast
hit.pixel.desc: A square shockwave spreads cell by cell as pixels scatter.

hit.flame.name: Flame Burst
hit.flame.desc: A tongue of fire shoots into the field and curls upward, leaving embers and smoke.

hit.heart.name: Rising Hearts
hit.heart.desc: A big heart pops out and little hearts float upward.

hit.wave.name: Sound Wave
hit.wave.desc: Arcs of sound push outward ring by ring, with an equalizer popping up at the wall.

hit.bolt.name: Lightning Strike
hit.bolt.desc: Two forking bolts crack down from the wall.

hit.notes.name: Note Fountain
hit.notes.desc: A stretch of staff is drawn from the wall, and notes are written onto it one by one, then float away.

hit.inkdrop.name: Ink Drop
hit.inkdrop.desc: Ink splatters, its edges bleeding into your combo color, then a brush draws a circle (ensō) beside it.

hit.tick.name: Precision Dial
hit.tick.desc: Every hit pops up a 60-tick dial with a needle sweeping around it.

hit.nova.name: Supernova
hit.nova.desc: Starburst plus fireworks plus two shockwave rings.

theme.stars.name: Starlight
theme.stars.desc: How the game looks now: night sky, glow frame, light ribbon trail and halo hit effect.

theme.aurora.name: Aurora
theme.aurora.desc: Green-blue aurora curtains flow across the night sky; rainbow bubble orb, triple braid trail, starburst.

theme.city.name: Neon City
theme.city.desc: A retro striped sunset, two layers of skyline and flickering neon signs; disco ball, lightning trail, lightning strike.

theme.sakura.name: Cherry Blossom Night
theme.sakura.desc: Cherry blossoms under the moon; double blossom orb, flower vine trail, bloom & fall on every hit.

theme.sea.name: Deep Sea
theme.sea.desc: Light beams from the surface and rising bubbles; bubble orb and splash.

theme.lava.name: Lava
theme.lava.desc: Dark red magma and rising embers; vinyl record orb, flame tongue trail.

theme.ice.name: Ice Crystal
theme.ice.desc: A snowy night sky; icicle frame, crystal orb, ice shatter.

theme.arcade.name: Pixel Arcade
theme.arcade.desc: An 8-bit grid background; block orb and pixel blast.

theme.candy.name: Candy
theme.candy.desc: A deep plum night and candy hills; rainbow frame, heartbeat orb and triple braid.

theme.galaxy.name: Galaxy Symphony
theme.galaxy.desc: A nebula background; double notes orb trailing a music staff, with notes fountaining on every hit.

theme.ink.name: Ink Wash
theme.ink.desc: An ink-wash night scene with layered distant mountains; ink bead orb, ink trace trail, spreading ink drop.

theme.gold.name: Golden Constellation
theme.gold.desc: Golden constellation lines, a gold frame, faceted star orb, comet tail and starburst.

plate.beacon.name: Beacon
plate.beacon.desc: A golden nameplate from the NT$300 supporter pack.

plate.ink.name: Ink Wash
plate.ink.desc: Rice-paper background with a black border.

plate.orbit.name: Star Trail
plate.orbit.desc: A frame with colorful star trails flowing around it.

plate.immortal.name: Immortal
plate.immortal.desc: Staff lines and notes keep flowing inside the frame.

avatar.orb.name: Light Dot
avatar.orb.desc: The default avatar: its glow color is your career-best combo tier (verified by the server).

avatar.crown.name: Star Crown
avatar.crown.desc: Legendary avatar with a ring of light that never stops flowing.

avatar.reticle.name: Crosshair
avatar.reticle.desc: Legendary avatar with a ring of light that never stops flowing.

avatar.laurel.name: Laurel
avatar.laurel.desc: Legendary avatar with a ring of light that never stops flowing.

avatar.gold.name: Gold Crown
avatar.gold.desc: From a supporter pack of NT$90 or more.

avatar.cons0.name: Old Melodies Badge
avatar.cons0.desc: Clear every song in the Old Melodies constellation.

avatar.cons1.name: Baroque Badge
avatar.cons1.desc: Clear every song in the Baroque constellation.

avatar.cons2.name: Classical Badge
avatar.cons2.desc: Clear every song in the Classical constellation.

avatar.cons3.name: Romantic Badge
avatar.cons3.desc: Clear every song in the Romantic constellation.

avatar.cons4.name: Opera & Song Badge
avatar.cons4.desc: Clear every song in the Opera & Song constellation.

avatar.cons5.name: Late Romantic Badge
avatar.cons5.desc: Clear every song in the Late Romantic constellation.

avatar.cons6.name: Christmas Badge
avatar.cons6.desc: Clear every song in the Christmas constellation.

avatar.cons7.name: Hymns Badge
avatar.cons7.desc: Clear every song in the Hymns constellation.

avatar.cons8.name: Nursery & Folk Badge
avatar.cons8.desc: Clear every song in the Nursery & Folk constellation.

avatar.cons9.name: Neon Badge
avatar.cons9.desc: Clear every song in the Neon constellation.

share.basic.name: Basic
share.basic.desc: The default score share card frame.

title.leapfrog.name: Leapfrog
title.leapfrog.desc: Clear a song you have never cleared before on Hard or higher the first time.

title.heaven.desc: Complete all 10 constellations and reveal all 6 bonus constellations, and the golden Musical Note appears.

title.hair.name: Rainbow Rider
title.hair.desc: Reach a 400 combo in one song.

title.bestfield.desc: Take 1st place in an 8-player room with a full combo.

title.finale.name: Finale Comeback
title.finale.desc: Go from last place to first in the final 10% of a match.

title.kindred.name: Kindred Spirit
title.kindred.desc: End a match with exactly the same accuracy as your opponent.

title.guide.name: Pathfinder
title.guide.desc: A friend you invited clears their first song.

title.ensemble.desc: Finish 10 matches in a room of 4 or more players with friends.

title.lifeline.name: Lifeline
title.lifeline.desc: Hint: “That was close” → clear a song with less than 10% life left.

title.persist.name: Fight On
title.persist.desc: Hint: “Failure is the mother of…” → clear a song after failing it 5 times.

title.lamplighter.name: Lamplighter
title.lamplighter.desc: Any supporter pack; light a lamp for this night sky.

avatar.lv30.name: Frame · Silver
avatar.lv30.desc: A silver frame with tick marks.

avatar.lv50.name: Frame · Gold
avatar.lv50.desc: A gold gradient frame with stars at the corners.

avatar.lv70.name: Frame · Platinum
avatar.lv70.desc: A platinum gradient frame over radiating light.

avatar.lv90.name: Frame · Starlight
avatar.lv90.desc: A starlight frame whose light never stops flowing.

orb.lv15.name: Note
orb.lv15.desc: A bold eighth note that bounces gently on the beat, with sound waves rippling out on both sides.

orb.lv50.name: Metronome
orb.lv50.desc: The pendulum of a metronome swings with the beat and flashes on both sides at the end of each swing.

trail.lv25.name: Note String
trail.lv25.desc: A string of notes laid out along the path, bobbing up and down in turn.

trail.lv65.name: Meteor Score
trail.lv65.desc: A gold meteor drags an unrolled staff behind it, with stars twinkling on the lines.

hit.lv35.name: Chord
hit.lv35.desc: Three notes stack into a chord on the staff, with a ring of light.

hit.lv75.name: Timpani
hit.lv75.desc: A timpani is struck: the head trembles and sound waves spread out ring after ring.

plate.lv20.name: Staff
plate.lv20.desc: A nameplate with a pale violet staff pattern.

plate.lv40.name: Music Stand
plate.lv40.desc: A dark wooden music stand with a metal bar along the top.

plate.lv60.name: Golden Staff
plate.lv60.desc: A gold staff pattern with a faintly glowing edge.

plate.lv80.name: Maestro's Manuscript
plate.lv80.desc: Yellowed parchment with an ink double-line border, like a maestro's manuscript.

bg.lv45.name: Concert Hall
bg.lv45.desc: Velvet curtains, gold arches, a chandelier and stage spotlights, with the silhouettes of the audience seats along the bottom.

bg.lv85.name: Starry Concert Hall
bg.lv85.desc: The hall roof opens onto the night sky, and notes drift up from the stage into the stars.

bg.lv100.name: Night of the Maestro · Background
bg.lv100.desc: Golden staves flow across a violet starry night, notes on the lines lighting up and fading.

frame.lv100.name: Night of the Maestro · Frame
frame.lv100.desc: A gold outer line with a thin violet inner line, stars at the corners and a note on the top edge.

orb.lv100.name: Night of the Maestro · Orb
orb.lv100.desc: A golden disc with an eighth note carved into it, circled by three small notes.

trail.lv100.name: Night of the Maestro · Trail
trail.lv100.desc: A wide gold-and-violet ribbon with a string of notes laid along it.

hit.lv100.name: Night of the Maestro · Hit
hit.lv100.desc: A chord rises, a starburst flashes, and a gold ring follows.

theme.lv100.name: Night of the Maestro
theme.lv100.desc: Golden staves flow across a violet starry night, with a note orb, a note-string trail, a chord and a starburst.

hit.companion.name: Companion Flare
hit.companion.desc: Two flares, one cyan and one gold, cross and spin in opposite directions. Only available by inviting a friend.
